title: TWO PUSHUPS // DISCOVERING VALYRIAN METALLURGY
narrative: In the Citadel library, Samwell drops his quill, sighs, and decides to do two pushups on the stone floor to impress Gilly. On his second pushup, his nose brushes against a loose floor tile, revealing a hollow lead cylinder containing the exact thermodynamic chemical formula for forging Valyrian steel using crushed dragonglass and pomegranate rind. 'Cardio really is good for you,' Sam pants, immediately eating a meat pie.
introducesPlotHole: Valyrian Steel Metallurgy Solved via Calisthenics

options.text: Unlock the deepest vaults of the Citadel to smelt a fleet of swords.
Warn the novice Pate before Jaqen steals the recipe.
Bring the formula to the glass candle observatory at the Hightower.
